dealer.name: Apex Motors
dealer.description: An independent dealership in Colombo offering brand-new and carefully inspected pre-owned vehicles, with financing assistance and trade-in valuations under one roof.
dealer.tagline: Your trusted vehicle partner in Colombo

items.q: Can I reserve a vehicle before visiting?
items.a: Yes. A refundable reservation deposit holds a vehicle for up to 72 hours while you arrange a viewing or finance. Contact our team to confirm the current deposit amount.

items.q: Are the prices on the website negotiable?
items.a: Listed prices reflect the condition, specification and market value of each vehicle. Our advisors are happy to discuss the total package, including trade-in value and finance terms.

items.q: What documents do I need to buy a car?
items.a: Your NIC or passport, proof of address, and — if you are financing — recent salary slips or business documents. We will confirm the exact list when you enquire.

items.q: Do you handle registration and transfer?
items.a: Yes. For brand-new vehicles we manage first registration with the DMT; for pre-owned vehicles we prepare the transfer documents on your behalf.
Every pre-owned vehicle goes through a multi-point mechanical, electrical and body inspection before it is listed. The report is available on request.

items.q: Can I bring my own mechanic?
items.a: Of course. Book a time with us and your mechanic can inspect the vehicle at our showroom.
We check service records and, where available, agent history to verify odometer readings before listing.

items.q: Do you offer leasing or loans?
items.a: We work with several banks and leasing companies to help you compare offers. Approval, rates and terms are decided by the lender.

items.q: How much down payment do I need?
items.a: It depends on the vehicle and lender, and on current regulatory loan-to-value limits. Our finance advisor will explain the minimum for your chosen car.

items.q: Is the online calculator a finance offer?
items.a: No. The calculator gives an illustrative estimate only. Your actual instalment will depend on the lender’s approved rate, fees and term.
We consider make, model, year, mileage, condition, service history and current market demand. You receive a clear, itemised valuation after inspection.

items.q: Can I trade in a car that is still under lease?
items.a: Yes. We can settle the outstanding balance with your lender and deduct it from the valuation.

items.q: Do I have to buy from you to sell my car?
items.a: No. We also purchase vehicles outright, subject to inspection.

items.q: Do brand-new vehicles include a warranty?
items.a: Brand-new vehicles carry the warranty terms provided by the manufacturer or importer. We will share the exact coverage for your chosen vehicle.

items.q: Is there a warranty on pre-owned vehicles?
items.a: Selected pre-owned vehicles may include a limited dealership warranty or remaining manufacturer cover. Ask our team about the specific vehicle you are interested in.
Monday to Friday 9:00 am – 6:30 pm and Saturday 9:00 am – 5:00 pm. Sunday and Poya day visits are by appointment.
Yes — WhatsApp is often the fastest way to reach us. Use the WhatsApp button on any vehicle page and the vehicle details are included automatically.

items.q: Do you deliver vehicles outside Colombo?
items.a: Delivery island-wide can be arranged. Charges depend on the distance; our team will confirm when you purchase.

products.title: Land Cruiser Prado
products.description:
The new-generation Prado returns to its roots with a squarer, more purposeful body, a reinforced ladder frame and a cabin that finally matches its price point. This example is brand new, unregistered and supplied with full manufacturer documentation.

The 2.8-litre turbo-diesel pairs with an 8-speed automatic and full-time 4WD with a lockable centre differential, so it is as composed on the Kandy road as it is on an estate track. Seven seats, with the third row folding flat into the floor.

vehicle.tagline: The all-new generation, built for every road the island has.

products.title: Vezel
products.description:
One local owner, 8,400 km, serviced at the agent. The e:HEV system runs on electric power for most city driving, which is where it returns its best economy.

The Z grade adds the larger touchscreen, LED lighting and Honda Sensing. Interior is clean with no wear on the bolsters; the battery health report is available on request.

vehicle.tagline: Hybrid economy in a body that works in Colombo traffic.

products.title: Corolla Cross
products.description:
Brand new and unregistered. The Corolla Cross Hybrid is the quiet favourite of families who want SUV height without SUV running costs.

The 1.8-litre hybrid system is proven and simple to maintain, and the boot comfortably takes a week of luggage.

vehicle.tagline: A sensible family SUV, done properly.

products.title: Swift
products.description:
A tidy RS-grade Swift with 21,500 km and a full Suzuki service record. Ideal as a first car or a dependable city runabout.

The CVT gearbox keeps it smooth in stop-start traffic, and parts and servicing are inexpensive island-wide.

vehicle.tagline: Light, nimble and easy to own.

products.title: X5
products.description:
A plug-in hybrid X5 in M Sport trim with 34,200 km. The 3.0-litre straight-six and electric motor together produce 394 hp, with around 70 km of electric range for daily commuting.

Two previous owners, agent maintained, with a recent independent battery and body inspection on file.

vehicle.tagline: Six-cylinder refinement with a plug-in conscience.

products.title: C-Class
products.description:
AMG Line C 200 with 15,800 km and a single owner. The 1.5-litre turbo with EQ Boost mild-hybrid is quietly quick and impressively economical.

Currently reserved pending finance approval — enquire to be notified if it becomes available again.

vehicle.tagline: A small S-Class in every way that matters.

products.title: X-Trail
products.description:
The e-POWER X-Trail is driven solely by its electric motors; the 1.5-litre engine acts as a generator. The result is EV-like smoothness with no charging required.

This brand-new example has the e-4ORCE twin-motor AWD system and seven seats.

vehicle.tagline: Electric drive, with the petrol engine only ever charging.

products.title: Civic
products.description:
Eleventh-generation Civic RS with 18,900 km and agent service history. The 1.5 turbo is lively and the chassis is one of the best in its class.

Clean, unmarked interior; both keys and owner manuals present.

vehicle.tagline: A grown-up Civic with a sense of humour.

products.title: Sportage
products.description:
A brand-new GT-Line Sportage, currently in transit and expected in our showroom within three weeks. Reservations are open.

The dual curved panoramic display and generous standard equipment make it one of the most complete SUVs at this price.

products.title: Yaris
products.description:
A single-owner Yaris with 32,600 km and a complete service book. Light steering and a tight turning circle make it easy in the city.

Recently serviced with new tyres fitted.

vehicle.tagline: Toyota reliability in a compact, frugal package.

products.title: Defender
products.description:
A brand-new Defender 110 in X-Dynamic HSE specification, finished in Gondwana Stone. The D300 mild-hybrid straight-six delivers effortless torque with surprising refinement.

Air suspension, Terrain Response 2 and 900 mm wading depth mean it goes wherever the road ends — then drives home in near silence.

products.title: Tucson
products.description:
Premium-grade Tucson with 26,300 km and one careful owner. The parametric grille with hidden lights still turns heads.

Under manufacturer warranty until 2026; full inspection report available.

vehicle.tagline: Distinctive styling with a spacious, practical cabin.

products.title: Noah
products.description:
The family carrier of choice: 11,200 km, captain seats in the second row and powered sliding doors on both sides.

The 1.8 hybrid keeps running costs low even when fully loaded for the trip down south.

vehicle.tagline: Seven seats, two sliding doors, very little fuel.

products.title: 4 Series Coupé
products.description:
M440i xDrive Coupé with 9,700 km. The 374 hp straight-six and all-wheel drive make it devastatingly quick in any weather.

Kept garaged, ceramic-coated from new, with full BMW service history.

vehicle.tagline: A straight-six grand tourer for the long way home.
